text: minimum promoters’ contribution including contribution made by alternative investment funds or foreign venture capital investors or scheduled commercial banks or public financial institutions or insurance companies registered with Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India

source.span_hint: minimum promoters contribution including

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Promoter lock-in period
text: promoters’ holding in excess of minimum promoters’ contribution shall be locked-in for a period of six months from the date of allotment in the initial public offer.

source.span_hint: promoters holding in excess of minimum

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in period for capital expenditure use
text: Provided that in case the majority of the issue proceeds excluding the portion of offer for sale is proposed to be utilized for capital expenditure, then the lock-in period shall be three years from the date of allotment in the initial public offer.

source.span_hint: Provided that in case the majority of

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Definition of Capital Expenditure
text: For the purpose of this sub-regulation, “capital expenditure” shall include civil work, miscellaneous fixed assets, purchase of land, building and plant and machinery, etc. [and repayment of existing loan(s) that may have been taken for the purpose of such capital expenditure.]

source.span_hint: For the purpose of this sub-regulation

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in period for SR equity shares
text: The SR equity shares shall be under lock-in until conversion into equity shares having voting rights same as that of ordinary shares or shall be locked-in for a period specified in sub-regulations (1), whichever is later.

source.span_hint: The SR equity shares shall be under lock-in

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: (1)(a) proviso - Lock-in period for capital expenditure
text: in case the majority of the issue proceeds excluding the portion of offer for sale is proposed to be utilized for capital expenditure, then the lock-in period shall be three years from the date of allotment in the initial public offer.

source.span_hint: in case the majority of the issue proceeds

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in period for non-promoter pre-issue capital
text: The entire pre-issue capital held by persons other than the promoters shall be locked-in for a period of six months from the date of allotment in the initial public offer:

source.span_hint: The entire pre-issue capital held by persons other than the promoters

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Exclusion for pre-IPO employee share allotments
text: nothing contained in this regulation shall apply to: equity shares allotted to employees, whether currently an employee or not, under an employee stock option or employee stock purchase scheme [or a stock appreciation right scheme] of the issuer prior to the initial public offer
notes: This clause provides an exclusion for certain pre-IPO share allotments and does not impose any measurable check.

source.span_hint: nothing contained in this regulation shall apply

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Employee equity shares pre-IPO
text: equity shares allotted to employees, whether currently an employee or not, under an employee stock option or employee stock purchase scheme [or a stock appreciation right scheme] of the issuer prior to the initial public offer
notes: This clause does not specify any measurable check that can be represented as a stable issuer/offer fact.

source.span_hint: equity shares allotted to employees

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: (b) Employee Stock Options Trust
text: equity shares held by an employee stock option trust or transferred to the employees by an employee stock option trust pursuant to exercise of options by the employees, whether currently employees or not, in accordance with the employee stock option plan or employee stock purchase scheme [or a stock appreciation rights scheme].
notes: This clause describes the conditions under which equity shares can be held by an employee stock option trust and transferred to employees. It does not specify any measurable check or threshold that can be represented as a stable issuer/offer fact.

source.span_hint: equity shares held by an employee stock option trust

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: (c) equity shares held by funds/investors
text: equity shares held by a venture capital fund or alternative investment fund of category I or Category II or a foreign venture capital investor:
notes: This clause does not specify any measurable check that can be represented as an issuer/offer fact.

source.span_hint: equity shares held by a venture capital fund

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in period for VCF/AIF/FVCI purchases
text: such equity shares shall be locked in for a period of at least six months from the date of purchase by the venture capital fund or alternative investment fund [of Category I or Category II] or foreign venture capital investor.

source.span_hint: such equity shares shall be locked in for a period

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in provisions exemption for green shoe option
text: The lock-in provisions shall not apply with respect to the specified securities lent to stabilising agent for the purpose of green shoe option, during the period starting from the date of lending of such specified securities and ending on the date on which they are returned to the lender in terms of sub-regulation (5) or (6) of regulation 57:
notes: This clause provides an exemption from lock-in provisions for specified securities lent to a stabilising agent for green shoe option purposes, but does not specify any measurable check that can be represented as a stable issuer/offer fact.

source.span_hint: The lock-in provisions shall not apply

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in period for returned securities
text: Provided that the specified securities shall be locked-in for the remaining period from the date on which they are returned to the lender.

source.span_hint: the specified securities shall be locked-in

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in period for partly paid-up securities
text: If the specified securities which are subject to lock-in are partly paid-up and the amount called-up on such specified securities is less than the amount called-up on the specified securities issued to the public, the lock-in shall end only on the expiry of three years after such specified securities have become pari passu with the specified securities issued to the public.
notes: The lock-in period is three years if certain conditions are met for partly paid-up securities.

source.span_hint: If the specified securities which are subject to lock-in

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in inscription for dematerialized securities
text: The certificates of specified securities which are subject to lock-in shall contain the inscription “non-transferable” and specify the lock-in period and in case such specified securities are dematerialised, the issuer shall ensure that the lock-in is recorded by the depository.

source.span_hint: The certificates of specified securities which are subject

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Pledging of locked-in securities by promoters
text: Specified securities[, except SR equity shares,] held by the promoters and locked-in may be pledged as a collateral security for a loan granted by a scheduled commercial bank or a public financial institution or a systemically important non-banking finance company or a housing finance company, subject to the following:

source.span_hint: Specified securities held by the promoters

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: (a) Loan for Financing Issue Objects
text: if the specified securities are locked-in in terms of clause (a) of regulation 16, the loan has been granted to the issuer company or its subsidiary(ies) for the purpose of financing one or more of the objects of the issue and pledge of specified securities is one of the terms of sanction of the loan;
notes: This clause does not specify a measurable check that can be represented as an issuer fact.

source.span_hint: if the specified securities are locked-in

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: (b) Pledge of locked-in securities
text: if the specified securities are locked-in in terms of clause (b) of regulation 16 and the pledge of specified securities is one of the terms of sanction of the loan.
notes: This rule does not specify a measurable check that can be represented as an issuer or offer fact. It describes a condition under which certain actions are taken, but it is procedural and cannot be directly mapped to a field.

source.span_hint: if the specified securities are locked-in

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in period for pledged securities
text: Provided that such lock-in shall continue pursuant to the invocation of the pledge and such transferee shall not be eligible to transfer the specified securities till the lock-in period stipulated in these regulations has expired.

source.span_hint: such lock-in shall continue

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Transfer of locked-in securities
text: Subject to the provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, the specified securities[, except SR equity shares,] held by the promoters and locked-in as per regulation 16, may be transferred to another promoter or any person of the promoter group or a new promoter and the specified securities held by persons other than the promoters and locked-in as per regulation 17, may be transferred to any other person holding the specified securities which are locked-in along with the securities proposed to be transferred:
notes: This clause does not specify a measurable check or constraint that can be represented as an issuer fact.

source.span_hint: Subject to the provisions of Securities and Exchange Board

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Lock-in period continuation for specified securities
text: Provided that the lock-in on such specified securities shall continue for the remaining period with the transferee and such transferee shall not be eligible to transfer them till the lock-in period stipulated in these regulations has expired.

source.span_hint: lock-in on such specified securities

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

title: Appointing Lead Managers
text: The issuer shall appoint one or more merchant bankers, which are registered with the Board, as lead manager(s) to the issue.

source.span_hint: The issuer shall appoint one or more merchant bankers

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

part.title: APPOINTMENT OF LEAD MANAGERS, OTHER INTERMEDIARIES AND

title: (2) Lead Manager Responsibilities
text: Where the issue is managed by more than one lead manager, the rights, obligations and responsibilities, relating inter alia to disclosures, allotment, refund and underwriting obligations, if any, of each lead manager shall be predetermined and be disclosed in the draft offer document and the offer document as specified in Schedule I.

source.span_hint: Where the issue is managed by more than one lead manager

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

part.title: APPOINTMENT OF LEAD MANAGERS, OTHER INTERMEDIARIES AND

title: Disclosure requirement for lead manager associates
text: At least one lead manager to the issue shall not be an associate (as defined under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Merchant Bankers) Regulations, 1992) of the issuer and if any of the lead manager is an associate of the issuer, it shall disclose itself as an associate of the issuer and its role shall be limited to marketing of the issue.

source.span_hint: At least one lead manager to the issue

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

part.title: APPOINTMENT OF LEAD MANAGERS, OTHER INTERMEDIARIES AND

title: Appointment of Registered Intermediaries
text: The issuer shall, in consultation with the lead manager(s), appoint other intermediaries which are registered with the Board after the lead manager(s) have independently assessed the capability of other intermediaries to carry out their obligations.
notes: This clause does not specify a measurable check or constraint that can be represented as an issuer fact.

source.span_hint: The issuer shall appoint other intermediaries

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

part.title: APPOINTMENT OF LEAD MANAGERS, OTHER INTERMEDIARIES AND

title: Agreement with lead manager and other intermediaries
text: The issuer shall enter into an agreement with the lead manager(s) in the format specified in Schedule II and enter into agreements with other intermediaries as required under the respective regulations applicable to the intermediary concerned:

source.span_hint: The issuer shall enter into agreement

chapter.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFER ON MAIN BOARD

part.title: APPOINTMENT OF LEAD MANAGERS, OTHER INTERMEDIARIES AND

title: (Provided) - Agreements with Intermediaries
text: Provided that such agreements may include such other clauses as the issuer and the intermediaries may deem fit without diminishing or limiting in any way the liabilities and obligations of the lead
notes: This clause does not impose a measurable check but rather allows flexibility in agreements.

source.span_hint: such agreements may include such other clauses
